summary: The single application predicate change exactly implements submitted/.trial-public/brief.md and CONTRACT.md: strict clearance comparison with positive-area overlap rejection at zero clearance. No application correctness or scope defect found by source inspection.

findings.title: Boundary tests do not assert result count
findings.detail: zip silently truncates if the application returns fewer results than requested, including an empty results array. The new batch boundary tests could report success without checking every fixture.
findings.recommendation: Assert len(results) equals the batch size before iterating, or use zip with strict=True.

assessment.behavior: Squared gap distance now uses <, so horizontal, vertical, and diagonal equality pass. Edge and corner contact at zero clearance pass; positive-area intersection and containment still fail via the unchanged overlap term.
assessment.arithmetic: Existing schema limits coordinates to +/-1,000,000 and dimensions/clearance to at most 1,000,000 with at most 1000 unit scaling. The two squared gaps total less than 8e18 and remain in signed i64; this edit introduces no arithmetic changes.
assessment.regressions: Serialization, ordering, schema validation, connectivity and normalized rectangle construction are unchanged. Existing CLI tests already assert equality and touching behavior.
assessment.tests: New public JSON-interface fixtures cover equality and nearby thresholds, both units, input order reversal, edge/corner contact, overlap, containment, and a maximum-clearance scaled 3-4-5 case. Full returned result objects are checked. The new suite is registered in verify.json.
assessment.ownership_and_maintainability: No ownership or generic structure changes. Small predicate fix and a concise explanatory comment preserve existing architecture.
assessment.scope: Only the clearance predicate, dedicated tests, and verification registration change. No fixed-case application workaround found.

limitations: Static source review only; no build or tests executed and no Guardian gate exercised.

No parent trial state, private cases, grading, transcripts or external experiment reports inspected. Accidental exposure to historical timing text embedded in the supplied README was disregarded; no new-run timing information was inspected.
